mapper.insert: insert into data_dict_cat_detail (cat_code, dict_code, dict_name, create_time, modify_time) select cat_code, #{dictCode}, #{dictName}, #{now}, #{now} from data_dict_cat where cat_code = #{catCode} and is_delete = 0 on conflict (cat_code, dict_code) do update set dict_name = excluded.dict_name, modify_time = excluded.modify_time, is_delete = 0
